basic_details.job_title: NIT Raipur Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Technology Raipur (NIT Raipur) has announced 1 vacancy for the Project Assistant post on a project-based and purely temporary basis. Eligible candidates with B.E./B.Tech. in Civil Engineering or equivalent branches with minimum 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA, and below 30 years of age on the date of interview, can attend the walk-in interview on 22 October 2026 at the Department of Mechanical Engineering, NIT Raipur. The notified consolidated pay for the post is Rs. 16,500. Applicants must be present at the venue 30 minutes before the interview time and bring a duly filled applica

age_limit.details: Max. 30 years on the date of interview.

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: B.E./B.Tech. in Civil Engineering or equivalent branches with minimum 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA (out of 10) in B.E./B.Tech.

qualification.details: Desirable qualifications include knowledge of water audit and of basic documentation software.

important_instructions: The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, with a tenure of 3 months only from the date of joining. The Project Assistant will not be entitled to any regular leave, but is allowed to have CL and RH as per NITRR rules. The Project Assistant is required to adhere to administrative, financial, and disciplinary regulations of NITRR, and regular attendance will be maintained. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview, which will be held in offline mode only. The Institute reserves the right to cancel the post without assigning any reason. For any query, candidates may contact the principal investigator.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for NIT Raipur Project Assistant recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 22 October 2026 from 11:30 AM onwards.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates are advised to arrive at the venue by 11:00 AM (30 minutes before the interview time). The venue is the Department of Mechanical Engineering, National Institute of Technology Raipur, Raipur, CG.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Project Assistant post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess B.E./B.Tech. in Civil Engineering or equivalent branches with a minimum of 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA (out of 10) in B.E./B.Tech.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 30 years on the date of interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly fellowship or salary for this position?
faq.answer: The monthly consolidated fellowship is Rs. 16,500/-.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should candidates bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a duly filled application form, two passport-size photographs, one set of xerox copies of supportive documents for age, nationality, and qualifications, along with original documents.

faq.question: Q8. Is this position permanent?
faq.answer: No, the post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, with a tenure of 3 months only.

faq.question: Q9. What are the desirable qualifications mentioned in the notice?
faq.answer: Knowledge of water audit and of basic documentation software is desirable.

faq.question: Q10. Who is the Principal Investigator for this project?
faq.answer: Dr. Satish Kumar Dewangan, Associate Professor in the Department of Mechanical Engineering, is the Principal Investigator.
